answer.rationale: Finance mandates an 18% cost cut; the incumbent has refused to reopen price. memory_c2 records that moving primary supply to the low-cost vendor previously cut unit cost sharply with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing—directly relevant to whether a switch can meet the mandate without introducing delivery risk. The 14-day expiry forces action now; deferring is not viable because the contract does not auto-renew and the line is at 94% with no buffer. Adding a second source or negotiating terms cannot close an 18% gap in one move and does not address the imminent expiry. Verifying c2 before committing ensures the prior success was real and not an artefact of different conditions.
